first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person wearing a light-colored hood, brown top, light-colored hanging cloth, long ochre-yellow cloth strip, and dark boots, with a bow and shield carried on the back.

entities.name: stone passageway
entities.identification: A pale pinkish-beige transverse platform and an elevated stone walking surface extending toward the distant gateway pillars.

entities.name: cage brazier
entities.identification: A dark, openwork cage brazier beside the parapet wall on the left side of the passageway; one is discernible in this clip.

entities.name: wooden stake fence
entities.identification: A fence composed of closely spaced, slender gray-brown wooden stakes, with an uneven top edge, connecting rods, and diagonal braces in places.

entities.name: wood-roofed courtyard
entities.identification: A low courtyard whose nearby wooden-pole roof is covered with orange-brown sheeting.

entities.name: tower-wall complex
entities.identification: A complex composed of a tall reddish-brown tower, a long wall, square gateway pillars, and open-frame shelters.

entities.name: stone building complex
entities.identification: A small, low, square-shaped pale earthy yellow-gray stone building complex by the water on the left.

entities.name: layered rock face
entities.identification: An irregular reddish-brown to pale earthy yellow rock face with horizontal strata in the distant view on the left.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: Pale gray-white to pale yellow-gray sky above and in the gaps between the buildings and rock face.

entities.name: water surface
entities.identification: A blue-green to gray-green body of water extending along an irregular shoreline in the lowland on the left side of the passageway.

entities.name: vegetation
entities.identification: A group of plants outside the passageway, composed of yellow-green grasses, shrubs, broad-canopied trees, and tall palms.

entities.name: sandy ground
entities.identification: Pale yellow-brown sandy soil and gray-brown exposed rocky ground in the low area outside the passageway.

entities.name: domed stone parapet wall
entities.identification: A thick, pale pinkish-beige stone parapet wall along the left edge of the long passageway, with repeated rounded blocks arranged along its top.

entities.name: longbow
entities.identification: The long, slender yellow-brown bow with curved ends behind Person A.

entities.name: round shield
entities.identification: The dark green-black round shield with a brighter edge on Person A's back.

entities.name: woven mat
entities.identification: Light-brown rectangular or irregular mats of interwoven thin rods on the stone surface.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The gray-brown horse beside the distant wooden shelter on the right, with a relatively long head and neck and slender legs.

entities.name: thin black cable
entities.identification: A thin black line-like cable extending horizontally near the rock surface outside the left side of the passageway.
